runs.text: Tame Impala at Parque de Quetzalcóatl, Mexico, for Cercle

Tame Impala performing a DJ set inside Javier Senosiain’s surreal creation, Parque Quetzalcóatl, in Mexico.

Founder & artistic director: Derek Barbolla
Directed by Mathieu Glissant
Images by Mickaël Fidjili, Augustin Thai, Alexis Olas, Arthur Maneint, Derek Barbolla
Extra footage by Colt Grice
Edit by Manon Metzger / Grade by Ines Sanchez

ABOUT THE ARTIST: TAME IMPALA

Tame Impala is one of the most influential voices of the last decade. A singular artist who writes, produces, plays, and mixes all his music, he crafts transcendent, genre-defying soundscapes. His latest album, ”Deadbeat”, showcases his visionary sound. A Grammy winner with multiple ARIA Awards, he has collaborated with Dua Lipa, The Weeknd, SZA, and more. Hits like ”The Less I Know The Better” have billions of streams, and he continues to headline festivals worldwide.
